comment: One subagent on the reply card: a panel of its own, collapsed, holding the brief it was given
and what it reported. Secondary by design — the run folds the answer into its own reply, and
this is where a reader goes to see what the work behind that reply actually was, starting with
what was asked for. The placeholders are filled in FeishuSubagentPanel: {panelId}, {bodyId} and
{footerId} are element ids, {title} says which subagent this is and how it is getting on,
{brief} is the task it was given, quoted, {body} is what it has said so far, and {footer} is
what it has spent saying it. A deployment replacing this file has to keep all six, keep the
brief first among the elements, and keep the body and footer elements text ones: the run streams
into both of them by id. The brief has no id of its own because nothing ever rewrites it alone.
The panel is styled exactly as the thinking, tool and knowledge-sources panes in
card-elements.json are, and for the reason a card wants one kind of pane rather than four: they
sit one under another on the same card, all four are a line a reader opens for something that
is not the answer, and a panel drawn differently from its neighbours reads as a different sort
of thing rather than as the same offer made about different work. So there is no border and no
padding around it — a box would be the card's only one — the title is notation-sized and grey
like theirs, 'auto_when_fold' keeps the closed line as narrow as that title while the report,
once opened, still gets the whole width to wrap in, and 'follow_text' puts the chevron beside
the title rather than off at the right edge of a row nothing else fills. The chevron is theirs
too and turns the same way: pointing right while the panel is closed and a quarter turn down as
it opens — the angle is what the icon is rotated by when expanded, not the angle it ends at.
The grey lives on the title's markdown rather than on the panel, because it is the header text
being coloured and not what the panel holds, and it wraps the placeholder rather than being
written into the message so that restyling stays in this file: FeishuSubagentPanel substitutes
{title} inside whatever this content wraps it in. This key is ignored when the panel is built.
